Scene:
发现了夹竹桃有毒。别人看到他，很快给他吃一个灵芝。神农一吃就觉得比较好。然后，他继续写他发现的信息。会告诉他的朋友哪一个植物能不能吃。

The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 发现了夹竹桃有毒：it is unclear that夹竹桃refers to黄色的花
- 别人看到他：另外一个人，“别(的)” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”
- 会告诉他的朋友哪一个植物能不能吃：也会告诉他的朋友哪一个植物能吃，哪个植物不能吃

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: 别人：一个男人，This word distinguishes other people from a stated person or group, but no such contrast exists here. Use a full noun phrase to introduce the unidentified person. [teacher rule: bieren]
Run 2: 别人：一个男人，别人 distinguishes other people from an already established speaker or group; no such group has been established here, so introduce the new helper with a noun phrase. [teacher rule: bieren]
Run 3: 别人：一个人，The narrator is not contrasting this person with themself or another stated person, so this word does not fit here; use an indefinite noun phrase for the newly appearing helper. [teacher rule: bieren]

output.reason: All runs identify the misuse of 别人 for a newly introduced helper and replace it with an acceptable indefinite noun phrase.
